Frequently asked questions

Common questions about dispute medical collections

How do I dispute medical collections?

Request itemized billing from the provider, compare with your EOB, identify billing errors, and dispute the collection citing specific errors.

Can medical collections be removed?

If inaccurate, unverified, or paid, you can dispute with credit bureaus. Paid medical collections under $500 may not appear on reports.
